source.title: EA SPORTS FC™ 27 Player Ratings
source.licence_text_quoted_from_readme: This is an unofficial, non-commercial snapshot for analysis and education, and it includes no imagery.
source.upstream: EA's public ratings API (per README); exported by the ea-fc-player-stats pipeline
source.acquisition: archive.zip supplied by the project owner (found at the owner's Downloads folder, file time 2026-09-23); copied unmodified into raw/ and hashed on 2026-09-29

redistribution: NOT redistributed. raw/ is excluded from version control (.gitignore); re-acquire from the Kaggle URL (version 4) and verify the hashes above.
policy_notes: RESEARCH_ONLY: never CANONICAL, never VERIFIED, never served by production read paths.
GK rows: pace/shooting/passing/dribbling/defending/physicality columns carry GK face stats and are not mapped to canonical outfield facades.
height_cm and weight_kg are blank on every row (EA has not published them); stored as UNKNOWN.
Both divisions present: gender column carries EA's labels "Men's Football" / "Women's Football", stored verbatim.
